name: Power Electronics
description:
Steady-state operating principles of switching converters
DC-DC power conversion: operation of buck, boost, and buck-boost converters, switch realization, loss mechanisms in switching converters - conduction and switching loss, continuous and discontinuous conduction mode operation, isolated DC-DC converters.
DC-AC power conversion: inverter circuit configurations and principle of operation, VSI and CSI, single and three-phase inverters, Square wave and sinusoidal PWM control methods, harmonic analysis and selective harmonic elimination.
AC-DC power conversion: uncontrolled, semi-controlled, fully controlled and dual converters in single-phase and three-phase configurations, design, phase control, harmonic analysis, firing circuits and their designs, improved power quality AC-DC converters
AC-AC power conversion: single-phase and three-phase ac voltage controllers, design and control.
Design of elements: capacitor selection and calculations, inductor and transformer design.
